tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tse'u dmar po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rta mchog rol par gus btud nas/ /pad+ma dbang gi phrin las pa/ /tse'u dmar po'i gtor bsngo bri/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs gtor ma byin rlabs dran tsam byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar btsan yul ri thang dmar po'i gnas g.ya' dang spang gis phyogs mtshams thams cad bskor zhing zangs brag dmar po mtshon cha zings pa 'dra ba'i bar snang la rgod rmug 'ug pa pho rog sogs dur bya mang po 'thab cing lding ba/ ri ngos la sha rkyang gna' ba sogs ri dwags rtsed 'jo dang / stag gzig dom dred sogs gcan gzan ngur sgra sgrog pa/ sa gzhi la chu sngon baiḍūr+ya'i mdog dang dam nyams kyi khrag rgyun 'khyil ba'i zhing khams yangs shing rgya che'i dbus su btsan mkhar dmar po gru bzhi pa la bse'i ba gam dung gi sgo mo lcags kyi sgo lcags mu men gyi them skas rnams kyis spras shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma du las myur 'gro g.yu sngon gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bstan srung chen po tse'u dmar po sku mdog dmar nag rab tu khros pa'i nyams can spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs shing / zhal dmar am gtsigs bsdams pa/ sma ra dang ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ dam nyams la khros pa'i khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ sku la bse khrab dmar po sdig pa'i lus can gyis gang ba gsol zhing sbrul nag po dang gser gyi ska bo che bcings pa/ snang srid gsal ba'i me long la dar snas brgyan pa/ dbu la bse rmog dmar po snod kyi ldem 'phru can la dar dmar gyi cod paṇa 'phur ba/ mu men dang byu ru'i do shal can stag dong dang gzig shubs 'chang ba/

zhabs la pags l+h+wam yu ring gsol ba/ chibs su bra bo 'gab nag g.yu sngon rin po che'i sga srab kyis brgyan pa la chibs pa/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar 'phyar bas sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung sdud cing / g.yon btsan zhags glog ltar 'khyug pas dam nyams kyi bla srog 'gugs pa/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du sprul pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang / dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / 'phags yul me 'bar gyi dur khrod/ li yul lcang ra smug po/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa nas gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po/ lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po/ gnod sbyin yang le ber/ kun khyab drag po rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥ rang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /gnod sbyin dmar po gtum rngam mthu rtsal can/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po rjes dgongs la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ hrīḥyak+ṣa rā dza sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥyak+ṣa rā dza sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/
dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod sogs dkyus 'gre/ de yang kun blos smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsi'u dmar po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
